asrBaseUrl.label: Speech recognition address
asrBaseUrl.hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint up to /v1, preset to the HRZ AI gateway with jlu/whisper-1. Several Speaches workers separated by commas; the chunks of a job go to them in turn. Transcription uses POST /audio/transcriptions (verbose_json, word timing where the server gives it).

asrConcurrency.label: Simultaneous requests to the servers
asrConcurrency.hint: Requests to speech and speaker recognition at once, across all jobs of this server process (like kiChat's SPEACHES_MAX_CONCURRENCY). As many as the servers have model instances; from 1 to 32.

providerName.label: Provider name
providerName.hint: Saved with every transcription, such as KI@JLU.

asrModels.label: Speech models
asrModels.hint: At most {{max}}. The list can be fetched from the endpoint; display names you gave stay.

defaultAsrModel.label: Speech model of jobs
defaultAsrModel.hint: Without a choice, the first of the list.

diarizationEnabled.label: Recognise speakers
diarizationEnabled.hint: Analyses the voices before transcribing, so they can be named, and assigns the transcript's segments to them. Without it, or while the server cannot be reached, every file has one automatic voice.

diarizationUrl.label: Speaker recognition address
diarizationUrl.hint: Speaches server up to /v1 with POST /audio/diarization and /audio/speech/timestamps, such as https://hrz-spark-03.hrz.uni-giessen.de/diarization/v1. Empty: the speech recognition address (the HRZ AI gateway offers no speaker recognition). Without an API key of its own, the speech recognition key is used.

llmBaseUrl.label: AI endpoint address
llmBaseUrl.hint: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint up to /v1 for correction, titles, subtitles, summaries and speaker optimisation. The HRZ AI gateway is preset; enter its API key below.

llmModels.label: AI models
llmModels.hint: At most {{max}}. The list can be fetched from the endpoint; display names you gave stay. Only listed models are used; without models the AI stays off.

defaultCorrectionModel.label: Model for quick tasks
defaultCorrectionModel.hint: AI correction, speaker optimisation, title and subtitle. jlu/qwen3.8-27b-fast is preset; it applies once it is in the list, else the first of the list.

defaultSummaryModel.label: Summary model
defaultSummaryModel.hint: Summaries and template previews. jlu/qwen3.8-27b is preset; it applies once it is in the list, else the first of the list.

llmDisableThinking.label: Turn off the models’ thinking
llmDisableThinking.hint: Sends chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking = false, which vLLM servers with Qwen3 models understand (HRZ gateway): the models answer at once instead of reasoning first. Turn it off for endpoints that refuse unknown parameters, such as OpenAI.

admin.fetchedModelsOmitted_one: {{count}} more above the maximum of {{max}} left out.
admin.fetchedModelsOmitted_other: {{count}} more above the maximum of {{max}} left out.

fetchModelsErrors.failed: The models could not be fetched. Check the address and the API key.

defaultLanguage.label: Language
defaultLanguage.hint: What new uploads start with; people can change it.

defaultSpeakerCount.label: Number of speakers
defaultSpeakerCount.hint: What new uploads start with; people can change it.

defaultLlmCorrection.label: AI correction on by default
defaultLlmCorrection.hint: Only takes effect when an AI endpoint with models is set up.

maxDurationMinutes.label: Longest recording (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.hint: Empty: no limit besides the file size.

maxActiveJobsPerUser.label: Running jobs per person
maxActiveJobsPerUser.hint: Jobs uploading, being analysed or transcribed at the same time.

chunkSeconds.label: Chunk length (seconds)
chunkSeconds.hint: Long recordings are cut into chunks of this length before recognition.

upstreamTimeoutSeconds.label: Time limit per request (seconds)
upstreamTimeoutSeconds.hint: How long a request to speech recognition, speaker recognition or the AI endpoint may take.

transcriptRetentionHours.label: Delete saved transcripts after (hours)
transcriptRetentionHours.hint: Counted from the last change. Empty: they stay until the person deletes them.

unsavedJobRetentionHours.label: Delete unsaved jobs after (hours)
unsavedJobRetentionHours.hint: Failed and cancelled ones too, each with its audio.

realtimeModes.label: Offered modes
realtimeModes.hint: Local needs the realtime bridge and a gateway (without its own: speech recognition), OpenAI the API key for OpenAI Realtime.

defaultRealtimeMode.label: Default mode
defaultRealtimeMode.hint: Without a choice, the first one offered.

onpremSignalingUrl.label: Realtime bridge address
onpremSignalingUrl.hint: The bridge from infra/realtime-bridge as this server reaches it, such as http://localhost:8089 or http://host.docker.internal:8089. The server passes the browser’s SDP offer on to POST /realtime; browsers reach the bridge over WebRTC only.

onpremGatewayUrl.label: Live transcription gateway
onpremGatewayUrl.hint: Up to /v1; the bridge streams to its /v1/realtime. Empty: the speech recognition address. For every session the server hands the bridge the speech recognition API key; browsers never get it.

onpremRealtimeModel.label: Gateway live model
onpremRealtimeModel.hint: The gateway’s realtime model, voxtral-mini-realtime as in kiChat. The API key must be allowed to use it.

iceServers.label: ICE servers
iceServers.hint: One server per line, several addresses separated by spaces, such as turn:turn.uni-giessen.de:3478. At most 5, for the local mode only. No credentials here: see TURN sign-in.

realtimeTurnAuth.label: TURN sign-in
realtimeTurnAuth.hint: Short-lived: for every session the server makes credentials for the turn: servers from the shared secret TRANSCRIPTION_TURN_SECRET (coturn use-auth-secret). The secret never leaves the server; browsers get credentials that expire.

realtimeTurnCredentialSeconds.label: TURN credential lifetime (seconds)
realtimeTurnCredentialSeconds.hint: How long a session’s TURN credentials work, 60 to 86,400 seconds.

openaiRealtimeUrl.label: OpenAI API address
openaiRealtimeUrl.hint: Up to /v1. The server gets short-lived keys there; browsers send their SDP offer to /realtime/calls.

openaiRealtimeModel.label: OpenAI transcription model
openaiRealtimeModel.hint: Set at the start of every session.

admin.storageHint: Storage is set up with the server's TRANSCRIPTION_S3_* environment variables. Without storage, no uploads are possible.
